{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 146,
      "where": "Proposition 9.11, hypothesis that C is generating",
      "scan": "génératrice par épimorphisme stricts",
      "tex": "génératrice par épimorphisme stricts",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "génératrice par épimorphismes stricts",
      "note": "The printed noun lacks its plural s. The TeX keeps the misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 146,
      "where": "Proof, paragraph beginning « Le fait que »",
      "scan": "tout objet de E soit accessible",
      "tex": "tout objet de $E$ soit accessible",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "tout objet de $E$ soit préaccessible",
      "note": "This is the first assertion of 9.11, proved by Lemma 9.11.1: preaccessibility, not accessibility. The TeX keeps the printed misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 146,
      "where": "Same proof paragraph, before Lemma 9.11.1",
      "scan": "l'ensemble des sous-objets stricts de E est petit",
      "tex": "sous-objets stricts de $E$ est petit",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "sous-objets stricts de $X$ est petit",
      "note": "The subobjects are those of the object X just introduced, not of the category E. The TeX keeps E."
    },
    {
      "page": 146,
      "where": "Lemma 9.11.1, bound on the number of strict subobjects",
      "scan": "soit de cardianl majoré",
      "tex": "soit de cardinal majoré",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "soit de cardinal majoré",
      "note": "The print has the transposition « cardianl ». The TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 146,
      "where": "Proof of Lemma 9.11.1, opening sentence",
      "scan": "I est un ensemble grand devant I",
      "tex": "grand devant $I$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "grand devant $\\Pi$",
      "note": "The second I should be the cardinal Π of the lemma. The TeX keeps the printed I."
    },
    {
      "page": 147,
      "where": "Proof of Lemma 9.11.1, choice of the subset I′",
      "scan": "\\card J\\leq\\Pi",
      "tex": "$\\card J\\leq\\Pi$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$\\card I'\\leq\\Pi$",
      "note": "The subset just chosen is I′; J has not been introduced. The TeX keeps the printed J."
    },
    {
      "page": 147,
      "where": "Proof of Lemma 9.11.1, after choosing a majorant j",
      "scan": "contient tous les",
      "tex": "contient tout les",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "contient tout les",
        "new": "contient tous les"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « tous », not « tout »."
    },
    {
      "page": 147,
      "where": "Lemma 9.11.2, final hypothesis",
      "scan": "π-préadmissible",
      "tex": "$\\Pi$-préadmissible",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$\\Pi$-préaccessible",
      "note": "The required property is Π-preaccessibility, established in Lemma 9.11.1 and used here to reduce the proof to surjectivity. The TeX keeps « préadmissible »."
    },
    {
      "page": 148,
      "where": "Displayed pair of composite arrows",
      "scan": "\\pr_1 v_\\alpha, \\pr_2 v_\\beta",
      "tex": "\\pr_1 v_\\alpha, \\pr_2\nv_\\beta",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "v_\\alpha\\pr_1, v_\\beta\\pr_2",
      "note": "Both compositions are printed in the wrong order: the projections from the fibre product must be applied first. The TeX keeps the printed order."
    },
    {
      "page": 148,
      "where": "Paragraph after the display, transition to the index i′",
      "scan": "Y_i\\rightarrow Y_{i'}",
      "tex": "$Y_i\\rightarrow Y_i$",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$Y_i\\rightarrow Y_i$",
        "new": "$Y_i\\rightarrow Y_{i'}$"
      },
      "note": "The target index in the print has a prime."
    },
    {
      "page": 148,
      "where": "Same sentence, agreement with « les composés »",
      "scan": "soient égales",
      "tex": "soient égales",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "soient égaux",
      "note": "The subject is the masculine plural « les composés ». The TeX keeps the printed agreement error."
    },
    {
      "page": 148,
      "where": "Construction of u_i near the end of the proof",
      "scan": "u_if_\\alpha=v_i",
      "tex": "$u_if_\\alpha=v_i$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$u_if_\\alpha=v_\\alpha$",
      "note": "The family of maps is indexed by α, so the right-hand side must be v_α. The TeX keeps the printed index i."
    },
    {
      "page": 148,
      "where": "Immediately after the construction of u_i",
      "scan": "p_iu_i=p",
      "tex": "$p_iu_i=p$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$p_iu_i=u$",
      "note": "The following calculation proves equality with u; no map p has been introduced. The TeX keeps the printed p."
    },
    {
      "page": 149,
      "where": "Definition 9.12 b), reference after L_{Π₀}",
      "scan": "(9.3)",
      "tex": "(\\hyperref[I.def9.3]{9.3})",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "(\\hyperref[I.def9.1]{9.1})",
      "note": "The condition L_Π is referred to 9.1 in both preceding lemmas; 9.3 is the reference for preaccessibility. The TeX keeps the printed 9.3."
    },
    {
      "page": 150,
      "where": "End of Definition 9.12 c), additional cardinal bound",
      "scan": "si X\\in\\ob\\Filt^{\\Pi}(E), \\Pi'\\geq\\Pi",
      "tex": "si $X\\in \\ob\n\\Filt^{\\Pi}(E)$, $\\Pi'\\geq \\Pi$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "si $X\\in \\ob \\Filt^{\\Pi'}(E)$, $\\Pi'\\geq \\Pi$",
      "note": "The printed filtration exponent is unprimed, and the TeX keeps it. The intended level is Π′: the clause bounds the presentation size by (Π′)^Π for an object of that level."
    },
    {
      "page": 150,
      "where": "Example 9.12.2, choice of the initial cardinal",
      "scan": "\\Pi_\\circ=\\aleph_\\circ",
      "tex": "$\\Phi_\\circ=\\aleph_\\circ$",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$\\Phi_\\circ=\\aleph_\\circ$",
        "new": "$\\Pi_\\circ=\\aleph_\\circ$"
      },
      "note": "The print has Π, not Φ."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "146: 0/5; 147: 1/2; 148: 1/4; 149: 0/1; 150: 1/1 (normal/misprint)."
}
